summary: Solomon solicits and gains Hiram’s help in getting timber to build the temple—The Israelites hew stones and cut timber for the temple.
meta_description: Solomon solicits and gains Hiram’s help in getting timber to build the temple—The Israelites hew stones and cut timber for the temple.

footnotes.note1_b: The Hebrew term here expresses the affection held by one friend for another; 1 Sam. 16:21; 18:1, 3.
footnotes.note18_a: HEB Givlim; i.e., Giblites, or inhabitants of Gebal. Josh. 13:5.
